verdict.rationale: Square's developer docs include a Refunds API with dedicated 'Refund Payments' and 'Process an Unlinked Refund' guides, so issuing refunds via the API is evidenced, though only as page titles. Nothing in the pack shows refunds being issued from the seller dashboard or explicitly confirms full versus partial refund amounts. Missing for 10: dashboard refund workflow, explicit full/partial refund support, substantive doc content beyond titles, independent or hands-on corroboration.
